svg.text: The table is row-sharded: each rank looks up only IDs received for the rows it owns.
CUB offset scans are preparation children; activity [79] is the actual embedding load kernel.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
